scope: Baal/Gnosis governance-event provider failure and cursor recovery

behavior.provider_failures: Provider initialization and event-fetch failures expose only safe summaries with exception classes.
behavior.cursor_recovery: An event-fetch failure aborts the current block batch instead of skipping the event type; the failed status update retains the last committed block rather than clearing or advancing the cursor.
behavior.persistence_failures: Database errors are class-only in status and logs; the failed batch is rolled back and the connection is closed.

coverage: secret-bearing provider initialization error is sanitized before database open
secret-bearing event query error aborts without cursor advance and preserves the last committed block
event persistence error rolls back and preserves the prior block cursor
protocol lookup errors are sanitized and connection cleanup runs

static_checks.database_or_provider_access: none; fake connections and mocked RPC objects only

limitations: No Gnosis RPC provider or database was contacted.
This does not establish historical receipt completeness, removed-log/deep-reorg rollback, or live provider behavior.
